status: Native acquisition, source provenance and scoped reference contracts prepared; predictive evaluation pending
working_title: SynRXN: A Source-Aware Benchmark Suite for Reaction Data
scope_policy: Twelve reaction-informatics families, fixed 41-task universe, all eight historical exports retained; multi-step synthesis route planning excluded. Native-source availability, redistribution permission and model evidence are separate gates.

data_policy.restricted_and_unresolved_sources: Retain unresolved source and internal-use-only history outside publication. Verified NC data are included with their terms; the reviewed PNAS factual table extraction has separate noncommercial educational conditions.

input_policy: Per-task whitelists; withhold targets, target-derived mappings/centers, source labels and identifiers unless their role is explicitly part of the scientific input. Known assay identifiers are allowed only for the declared conditional assay-activity task.
reference_policy: Keep measurements, expert judgments, generated labels, source annotations and computed quantities separate. Interpret replay and source-reference agreement within their exact scope.
split_policy: Retain upstream splits and provenance. Freeze scientifically appropriate source/group allocations before fitting. Do not apply the HiTEA fold design universally. Audit shared observations and source derivatives across tasks.
training_policy: One simple control and two suitable baseline families per qualified task/dataset by default; select on validation only; share permitted information within each task; archive attempted configurations and failures.

family_baselines.data: Text entity/relation extraction controls; conservative record-edit controls. Freeze document-level references and splits. Controlled deletion cases must remain labeled generated corruptions.
family_baselines.representation: Mapping/balancing wrappers; priors, fingerprints and learned classification/clustering; text precedent retrieval with linked expert references and unknown unannotated relevance.
family_baselines.transformations: Product/precursor retrieval or template controls and a competitive single-step model. Center prediction needs source-index qualification before classifier/graph baselines. No multi-step route search.
family_baselines.outcomes: Training median/class prior, fingerprint regression/classification and a learned molecular baseline; keep response definitions and FREA evidence tiers separate.
family_baselines.selectivity: Simple site/response controls plus fingerprint and graph/chirality-aware baselines where references support them; distinct target definitions remain distinct endpoints.
family_baselines.conditions: Frequency/retrieval controls and conditional set/sequence models; separate generic and role-aware target masks. Ranking and sequential selection score observed candidate pools.
family_baselines.physics: Quantity-specific scalar controls and suitable reaction models; configuration energy/force controls and learned reactive potentials under native trajectory holdouts; known-stoichiometry inverse kinetic fits on explicitly simulated examples. Units, direction, theory and reference validation remain source-specific.
family_baselines.mechanisms: Mapped-endpoint retrieval/template or electron-event models, endpoint-only diagnostics, symmetry-aware TS geometry controls and dynamical network-recovery controls under each acquired contract. Computed saddle references and simulated network examples retain their validation limits; synthesis route search is excluded.
family_baselines.analysis: Spectral integration/calibration controls and suitable learned mixture interpretation; persistence and past-only time-series forecasts. Derived integrals are not independent concentrations.
family_baselines.design: Training-set retrieval and conditional component/sequence generation; score validity and recorded-candidate recovery. Only observed candidates have a measured performance oracle. Substrate-scope discovery is bounded to recorded source attempts.
family_baselines.process: Mechanistic/linear controls and appropriate reactor-response models; bounded CSTR environment evaluation with published equations; coke-yield prediction remains a narrow impact quantity, not full LCA.
family_baselines.biocatalysis: Sequence/reaction retrieval, source-qualified mutation deltas, catalytic-residue references and per-record enzyme kinetic regression. Separate direct catalytic assays, DMS proxies and LLM-extracted evidence.

evaluation_policy: Source-specific metrics and denominators; model failures retained; dependence-aware paired uncertainty where applicable; multiple-comparison families declared before test inspection; no universal cross-task average of incompatible scores.

implementation_stages.goal: Reconcile twelve higher-level families, source bindings, explicit gaps and route-planning exclusion; preserve all eight original variants
Audit and pilot every original export variant; write standardized contracts for the additional source-backed tasks
Run and reproduce qualified baselines across the suite; publish a per-task readiness and result matrix
Deepen selected cross-family findings after broad task coverage; HiTEA is one case study

compute_allocation.meaning: Upper configuration-execution slots for the proposed matrix, not measured runtime or a claim that all model adapters exist. Deterministic algorithms do not require extra seeds. Per-source training-size caps and large-corpus budgets must be declared from pilots.
compute_allocation.runtime_and_hardware_estimate: Must be re-estimated from suite pilots; the former HiTEA-only CPU/GPU reservation does not cover this suite automatically.
reduction_order: Reduce the common validation search before test inspection
Use explicit source/group-aware training-size tiers for large corpora while preserving the declared test population
compute_allocation.coverage_rule: Do not remove the other tasks to simplify the HiTEA case study; retain every task and its honest readiness status.

case_studies.status: initial source preparation completed; human qualification and predictive runs pending
case_studies.role: optional detailed analysis within the full suite

delivery_policy: Acquisition gaps have scoped source variants; no automatic promise of complete model results. Execute only qualified, redistributable bindings after modality-specific pilots; freeze group splits, leakage checks and actual CPU/GPU/memory costs before the comparative matrix.

reproducibility.outputs: isolated source/export verification, regenerated artifacts, 41-task readiness and pending execution plan, command logs, code/environment/input snapshots
reproducibility.model_execution: not performed by this workflow; qualified predictive runners remain pending
